description: A local issue page (for example data centres in Phoenix): the sourced summary with its source links, who decides (the deciding body's current members, with ids for get_person), the next public meeting from the civic calendar, the petition when one exists, and how many people wrote to the deciders in the last 30 days. Give state, place and issue for one page; leave any of them out to list the published pages (optionally for one state). Summaries are Power Players' neutral, sourced descriptions; never present them as anyone's position.
name: get_local_issue
title: Get a local issue page
